_status: Both base-game Scenarios from the Core Rules. Board-specific space IDs referenced here (e.g. 220, 248, 10, 306) will resolve against future board data.

shared.evidence: Each of the 5 Zones has 1 Evidence token Hidden in it. Investigators must collect the required number for their player count and turn them in at any turn-in space.
shared.turnInAction: Turning in Evidence is an Involved Action; any number of Evidence tokens may be turned in during a single Action. For each token turned in, that Investigator chooses 1 reward.
rewardsRepeatable: Reveal any 1 Point of Interest's token
rewardsOncePerGame: Give any Investigator 1 Major Ability token
shared.objectiveUnlock: Once ALL required Evidence has been turned in, the Investigators take 1 random card for each of the two Scenario escape Objectives plus the Banish card matching the Adversary in play, and must select 1 of these Escape cards, completing its setup steps.
shared.gameEnd: Any Investigators who have not escaped and are still on the board after the final round count as being killed.

objectives.name: Power the Gate
steps: Collect the Lockbox token with an Interact Action and carry it to the Saw token.

Involved Action 'Open Lockbox' (only while carrying the Lockbox, on the Saw token; once per round for the whole team): place 1 Supply token on the Power the Gate player aid, then MAY push your luck with a D6 — Bright space: 1-2 gain a face-up Wound, 3-6 place 1 additional Supply; Dim/Dark space: 1-4 gain a face-up Wound, 5-6 place 1 additional Supply.
At 4 Supply tokens the Lockbox opens: gain the Fuse Objective Item card.
On the Locked Escape token's space, the Investigator with the Fuse takes an Involved Action to flip the token to its Escape side.
Every Investigator may now take an Interact Action on this space to escape.

objectives.name: Fix the Truck
steps: Collect 1 or more Part tokens (Battery, Repair Kit, Spark Plug) with Interact Actions and bring them to the Truck token.
Involved Action 'Install 1 Part' (on the Truck's space, requires carrying a Part; once per round for the whole team): install one Part on the player aid, left to right.
Involved Action 'Start the Truck' (on or adjacent to the Truck; once per round for the whole team): roll a D6 — 1 Part installed: succeed on 6; 2 Parts: 4+; 3 Parts: automatic success.
On success, every Investigator ON or ADJACENT to the Truck escapes immediately.
If not all Investigators escaped: place an Escape token on space 10 or 306; remaining Investigators may take an Interact Action there to escape (the driver rams the gate open).

objectives.reference: See adversaries.json banish section for the Adversary in play.

scenarios.name: The Amusement Park
scenarios.extraRepeatableReward: Flip all Mirror Maze Door tokens face-up and rearrange them
setupExtras: Place 1 Duck token on space 220 and 1 on space 248
The Adversary places the Mirror Maze tokens

rules: At the start of each round, the Adversary may rearrange the 3 Mirror Maze Door tokens face-down on the three colored spaces at the top of the Mirror Maze (choosing which color is open).
Investigators may not Move or Trade through Mirror Maze Doors without first taking an Interact Action (while adjacent to a doorway) to flip the corresponding token face-up.
Open icon: all Doors of that color/shape CAN be moved and traded through this round. Closed icon: cannot.
The Adversary may move through Open Doors without flipping tokens.
Mirror Maze Doors never block line of sight (mirrors reflect light in every direction).

tunnelOfLove.waterSpaces: The FIRST time an Investigator moves onto a Water space during their turn, they are immediately moved 2 spaces clockwise along the wavy Movement Lines. If this would end on another Investigator, they move as far as they can (possibly not at all).

rules: Interact Action while ON the game's space; each Investigator may use each Booth once per turn.
When a General Item is won from a Booth, remove its Duck token; that Booth cannot be used again.

games.testYourStrength: Spend any number of Stamina and roll a D6; +2 per Stamina spent. Gain a General Item on 5+. A natural 1 always fails.
games.duckHunt: Roll a D6; gain a General Item on 5+. +2 to the roll if your space is Bright.
games.ringToss: Roll 3 Sprint dice; may roll 1 extra die by spending 1 Stamina. May re-roll any number of dice by spending 1 Charge per re-roll. Gain a General Item on at least three 3's.

rules: Once per round, if a figure (Investigator or Adversary) starts on or moves onto a carriage space, they are immediately moved to the same position on the next carriage in line (if empty), following the pink arrows. This forced movement does not count as a Move or cost MP.
Figures cannot Move or Trade from carriage to carriage by themselves.
Carriage spaces connected by yellow dashed lines count as adjacent ONLY for Adversary Abilities and Attacks.

objectives.name: Fire the Flare
steps: Collect the Flare Gun token and at least 1 Ammo token with Interact Actions; bring them to the Locked Escape token.
Involved Action 'Fire Flare Gun' (requires carrying the Flare Gun AND Ammo, while on the Locked Escape token): place an Escape token 2 rounds out on the round tracker.
When that round is reached, help arrives: Investigators may take an Interact Action while in any carriage of the Ride listed on the Escape card to escape.

objectives.name: Service Tunnels
steps: Collect the Angle Grinder token with an Interact Action.

Involved Action 'Pick Up Ride Parts' (on the Ride Parts space): roll a D6 — Bright: gain a face-up Wound on a 1; Dim/Dark: gain a face-up Wound on 4 or less. The Ride Parts are picked up regardless of the roll.
Involved Action 'Open Service Tunnel' (requires carrying 1 Ride Part AND the Angle Grinder, while on the Locked Escape token): place an Escape token on the NEXT round of the round tracker.
At the start of the next round the lock is cut: flip the Locked Escape token to its Escape side; Investigators take an Interact Action on it to escape.
